behavior: Recognized A/H/V/RTX/GTX device IDs accompanied by hardware context must occur in that exact claim cited literal quote or bounded original context.
Another claim citation or a model-extracted condition cannot supply the device. RTX variants remain distinct; a literal match still needs independent semantic review.
Prospective device choices remain proposals rather than falsely requiring a paper measurement.
Planning requests minimum answer requirements without exhaustive extra scene-count/metric narration for short questions.
Repair preserves method variants and must cite the actual supporting condition passage or remove/narrow the condition.
Final coverage policy distinguishes an uncited source revealing a gap from a covered answer binding. Instructions are compacted without clipping original quotes or claims.

initialRegression.finding: Added redundant audit map/instructions broke prompt-reader fixtures and displaced a complete quote in the long-input capacity case.
initialRegression.resolution: Removed the duplicate map; condensed the existing policy. Original assertions and byte/call/token limits are unchanged. Targeted capacity/identity 30 passed, then complete suite passed.

boundary: Hard literal identity is a necessary check, never proof of hardware comparison fairness or semantic truth. No real .123 content score at deployment.
